_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0 — Gossamer app config for the NeuroPhone Android target. Sub-PR #3 (scaffold only) of the Kotlin->Rust/Gossamer migration epic (#83, RFC #97, sub-issue #109). Analogous to the former tauri.conf.json. JSON has no comment syntax, so SPDX/notes live in _comment keys. TODO(#83 sub-PR #4-#7): wire frontendDist to real UI, register IPC commands backed by the Rust core (crates/neurophone-core via crates/neurophone-android JNI), and port the foreground service + widgets.

build._comment: TODO(#83 sub-PR #4): point frontendDist at the real bundled web UI and add Deno build tasks. Placeholder content is loaded inline by NeurophoneMainActivity.getInitialHtml() for now.

security._comment: Webview-only scaffold. TODO(#83 sub-PR #5-#6): narrow capabilities once IPC commands and the sensor/service bridge land.

android._comment: Mirrors the legacy AndroidManifest minSdk=26/targetSdk=34 and arm64-v8a-first ABI set. TODO(#83 sub-PR #7): re-add BODY_SENSORS/FOREGROUND_SERVICE/RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED/WAKE_LOCK permissions when the service + widgets are ported.
